name: @symbiote-native/expo-modules-link
description: Native-module registration for apps using expo-modules-core wrapper packages (sensors, local-auth, haptics, ...). One app-level postinstall scans node_modules for every installed package's native-link.json and regenerates the app's app/build.gradle and MainApplication.kt registration blocks, so a new native module never needs a hand-edit.
author: Andrey Prokopenko <psevdoproger@gmail.com>
